price_note: Transcribed from the company's own printed FOOD/SWEETS and DRINK menu boards (version stamp 25.06, i.e. 2025-06), linked from the Shinjuku Marui branch page. Both boards print 価格は全て店内価格（税込）です — dine-in prices, 10% tax included. Prices approximate — may change. The whole café is 100% vegan; gluten is the variable, and the board separates the two explicitly.
